hero.title: Report cybercrime without navigating a maze.
hero.subtitle: Report cybercrime easily – guided, multilingual, secure, and backed by verified e-signing.
hero.noLegalTerms: No legal terminology needed. No lengthy forms to start.
cta.heading: Begin your complaint
cta.body: A guided process in five simple steps — describe what happened, add evidence, review, and sign securely. You can go at your own pace.
launcher.title: File a cybercrime complaint
launcher.subtitle: Tell us what happened in your own words.
launcher.placeholder: Describe what happened… e.g. “Someone called about my bank KYC and ₹35,000 was debited after I entered a UPI PIN.”
launcher.later: You can add screenshots, documents, messages or links later.
launcher.minChars: Please write at least a sentence so we can help.
launcher.listeningHint: Speak now — we're converting your voice to text.
emergency.title: Financial fraud? Act quickly.
emergency.body: If money was just transferred, calling within the first hour gives the best chance of stopping it.
secondary.heading: More ways we help
secondary.track.title: Track a complaint
secondary.track.body: Check the current status of an existing report.
secondary.check.title: Check a suspect
secondary.check.body: Has a number, UPI ID or website been reported before?
secondary.reportSuspect.title: Report a suspect
secondary.reportSuspect.body: Report suspicious numbers, accounts or links.
secondary.volunteers.title: Cyber Volunteers
secondary.volunteers.body: Help others stay safe in your community.
defense.heading: Before you become a victim
defense.subheading: Most cybercrimes can be spotted early. Check first, report early.
defense.checkBody: Has this number, UPI ID or website been reported before?
defense.reportBody: Received a suspicious call, SMS or link but didn't lose money?
learn.heading: Stay ahead of cyber scams
volunteers.heading: Help make the internet safer
volunteers.body: Cyber Volunteers work with State Police units to spread awareness, help citizens report correctly, and support cyber-hygiene drives in their communities.
govservices.heading: More government cyber services
govservices.subheading: Official services for SIM connections, lost devices and grievances.
